title: "Lecture 26 model nesting diagram"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    toc: false
---

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  "theme": "base",
  "themeVariables": {
    "fontFamily": "Roboto, Segoe UI, sans-serif",
    "primaryColor": "#f8f5f0",
    "primaryTextColor": "#3e3f3a",
    "primaryBorderColor": "#325d88",
    "lineColor": "#325d88",
    "secondaryColor": "#eef6df",
    "tertiaryColor": "#fff0e8"
  }
}}%%

flowchart TD
    full["<b>Separate regression lines</b><br/><code>Y ~ A * x</code>"]
    parallel["<b>Parallel regression lines</b><br/><code>Y ~ A + x</code>"]
    factor["<b>Factor-only model</b><br/><code>Y ~ A</code>"]
    single["<b>Single regression line</b><br/><code>Y ~ x</code>"]
    null["<b>Null model</b><br/><code>Y ~ 1</code>"]

    full --> parallel
    parallel --> factor
    parallel --> single
    factor --> null
    single --> null

    classDef flexible fill:#f8f5f0,stroke:#325d88,stroke-width:2px,color:#3e3f3a
    classDef intermediate fill:#fff0e8,stroke:#f47c3c,stroke-width:2px,color:#3e3f3a
    classDef simple fill:#eef6df,stroke:#93c54b,stroke-width:2px,color:#3e3f3a

    class full,parallel flexible
    class factor,single intermediate
    class null simple
    linkStyle default stroke:#325d88,stroke-width:2px
```
